Our country is in grave danger...
| [A LETTER FROM THE DESK OF CONGRESSMAN BRANDON GILL](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=1ebcd5a28e6c4b27abfd61f1329f8bc6&_e=WX6VsdfKQOTN5NULA0u-_b-QGvSxLtHRJKBxmLm3HvCjhxPo4sGwictg0vWZP0YlxS6JVZ4IMU-LrCdhAI7ZKntr-MSzL42dVE_ltUAy2oix7joR_77RrZQbTM4XEBUjXac_uaWboK33GPh2i71IExBJAlgo7re_sqFmgiAyUjrbXXh2bNuTJVXCHGjzf1WsVSHimq0kQx07SN2gKej9FfzDi8SN56YcFL8jo_fUGzsz2sbY7OHH7rC0K2qwUmnnmA2yrNR8dcWZlNyPMDvgOvadzsALzhzXGb0sBtjjEJYnKdJXu_97aoPPJuepolpKdYX4JGPJmrDdV0l0hbV7AU6HrfIX0iPIlMTUt3r_wkbwF9273iVduZev64jcYAFoElkEwx1ZqotOHkwNe7BLEP08zJJCeffQj21f8ARG1Df6PI91N1nL5kRvZVZwH6eegxGcEZXgHF-Uddpx_ZnKTZvTWrUp3lfPOrL9ZWbQ1tr0bBGdLKAYnWxOZ9vNIKIteeD7Mx4B_AY3yQI-xa5_wS4YzB16MvKIeykihhtadfz-3gzwtr49l8c-RHK1R-epEv9-LotUL_grVRcuDB6puSigA6w6yz1J8YYc6V6SSwBww_fNA3Q4l2VIZYa0uiw0yF-JP93hVVhmy2eIo-ycfAC_cVckbPc7s9DQpH5tDV_cPqpAVn7rvaAyL6wO1tIk0lTUc11RXDf9-30I-zfbXP-QFu8aOyyC6glUTwhOYybANZZGpxPnazuSouSFVPv6-tbstNV4pxajB8X_IBLxrd8_K0Xq-fjuubXVrlDsCNj69VJBwOHdRxTMX5jWoumtNoGsPRjh1v6t7fVFXWqbZ6f6M9IRQuL9YDRBH3YUJVMx2sftefDe38uIN7pY3Ce3suBk8Ei5tnhtLSU8NfegNQ%3D%3D)
Peter,
I understand that you get spammed with a whole lot of emails and texts from Republicans, especially in these final weeks of the midterms, so I try to avoid sending them whenever possible.
[When you see my name on your phone, I want you to know it’s about something that actually matters.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=1ebcd5a28e6c4b27abfd61f1329f8bc6&_e=WX6VsdfKQOTN5NULA0u-_b-QGvSxLtHRJKBxmLm3HvCjhxPo4sGwictg0vWZP0YlxS6JVZ4IMU-LrCdhAI7ZKntr-MSzL42dVE_ltUAy2oix7joR_77RrZQbTM4XEBUjXac_uaWboK33GPh2i71IExBJAlgo7re_sqFmgiAyUjrbXXh2bNuTJVXCHGjzf1WsVSHimq0kQx07SN2gKej9FfzDi8SN56YcFL8jo_fUGzsz2sbY7OHH7rC0K2qwUmnnmA2yrNR8dcWZlNyPMDvgOvadzsALzhzXGb0sBtjjEJYnKdJXu_97aoPPJuepolpKdYX4JGPJmrDdV0l0hbV7AU6HrfIX0iPIlMTUt3r_wkYfZHt63HuZTL3t3k12UWSr3AAl5YhNZTPY13RSHIb4IgdX3Vp5ExOLQ3M73ZQtPX8bkHBuFqw2y_qdoWDDP6hwpD9H7mkzQYTtJEA3cO5dqn8rt7n9v5BrKhPb4RwnRbjOrg4d-AwOYS1aYQfqyP-Gxfq8tFNDcJNq87_P540Z48khWMLmUnG1Q2b516I1VJoUMEmn3uzacKG_ToxYw4QCHOecdJYqHM20vW7YBTvRf33K21Ku-A3WYKNYdbZDQ_NEoGunM2Et36wb-6KTOuPAs-fV2IJiHUlsjEE374nbwLbzmj1VHXywBS8mpK_EIeID3e7mnjlCOs958-4ggWWSfLHQEYTEXNVaYtx7lz3mfihO8neGqAYo9f2yStFuyEKOoqx3psKvkqiDaBgT4KhZG51oxZKaaCSYpT7D7hXg77mE4u_H1aEoxROSQTue_qWFWTHPBf6AjeZwsOdYiwFS9w229ytXUV-FSzE_pPX2LCL6xb2MuIAdy4kiGlnNc2mPO2E7rjNWNkrJwGhkV3CwNNI91kx-MTtd2hv2WaMTNA%3D%3D)
Well, this might just be the single most important message I've ever written!
But because of that, I'm under pressure to make every word count - and honestly, it's really hard to find the right words to convey the scale of the threat facing America.
At this point, I've re-written this letter several times, and ultimately, I decided to just write to you straight from my heart with words inspired by my unwavering faith in God and our Country.
There are no media consultants or comms people changing my words or watering down my thoughts. This all comes straight from [ME](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=1ebcd5a28e6c4b27abfd61f1329f8bc6&_e=WX6VsdfKQOTN5NULA0u-_b-QGvSxLtHRJKBxmLm3HvCjhxPo4sGwictg0vWZP0YlxS6JVZ4IMU-LrCdhAI7ZKntr-MSzL42dVE_ltUAy2oix7joR_77RrZQbTM4XEBUjXac_uaWboK33GPh2i71IExBJAlgo7re_sqFmgiAyUjrbXXh2bNuTJVXCHGjzf1WsVSHimq0kQx07SN2gKej9FfzDi8SN56YcFL8jo_fUGzsz2sbY7OHH7rC0K2qwUmnnmA2yrNR8dcWZlNyPMDvgOvadzsALzhzXGb0sBtjjEJYnKdJXu_97aoPPJuepolpKdYX4JGPJmrDdV0l0hbV7AU6HrfIX0iPIlMTUt3r_wkZlNaeipMl33M6OGSQ1JFI30-Zvw5GZaBGcQ_oz1-TXozZBtOraANflzFRafa6YYRJ6ZVRVkteXnCfjtIFfgO2FQFLCdLzzCsSfjqUZgqjqHtxtKkaxBo4P1obCGmsU5DN1-i5W1arb62GHoPTr_yHnh3NmWrcdCOmCUbZpOjEnFxxjarMV_zKOauTv0FNjcARbQuNcz27K-VI2fEXWNnwhkEhUNk6HL-tA6T8roHRsPSK7QUsMeHzfULyDhzGvdQPIh1tN_ypFBTXam9CmCfzoIillzWjtEJMyWciAbC3-ebXLep8Dlg-wjbHw8-Ve5UglBylAqlnx8OqM6ZanNmUNYxubUYLNg4v9E9v3GZInyp9NPIKgw-jwA5hbNvKHenSzSeeBVZIj1MnkP2DRGEpytgwiKOpbvuh-uqj59HNMzIC_jfon0B-DMgK1N7heX6xKNad0izA5z85h5KqrTRNNheAvklQBL6AjKBu9cl9QH5kA3ufQCSq36GieZCLilbEZ0Fiz2ZoT_Uuv2Dt9xKd_T1g0oZu95KpHI-DWOuUN5A%3D%3D), so I apologize if it's a bit rough around the edges.
I'm not repeating the same worn-out talking points you're probably used to!
Look - I know the mainstream media is downplaying it, but the Democrat Party is getting more and more extreme, to the point that I believe they pose a threat to our free Republic.
They're embracing Communists, pro-Sharia candidates, and all kinds of radical Leftists who HATE conservatives, Christians, and the very values that made our country great.
There was a time not too long ago when American voters would punish this kind of extremism at the ballot box.
But instead, polling shows the Democrats are SURGING to their largest ever lead - [11 points](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=1ebcd5a28e6c4b27abfd61f1329f8bc6&_e=WX6VsdfKQOTN5NULA0u-_b-QGvSxLtHRJKBxmLm3HvCjhxPo4sGwictg0vWZP0YlxS6JVZ4IMU-LrCdhAI7ZKntr-MSzL42dVE_ltUAy2oix7joR_77RrZQbTM4XEBUjXac_uaWboK33GPh2i71IExBJAlgo7re_sqFmgiAyUjrbXXh2bNuTJVXCHGjzf1WsVSHimq0kQx07SN2gKej9FfzDi8SN56YcFL8jo_fUGzsz2sbY7OHH7rC0K2qwUmnnmA2yrNR8dcWZlNyPMDvgOvadzsALzhzXGb0sBtjjEJYnKdJXu_97aoPPJuepolpKdYX4JGPJmrDdV0l0hbV7AU6HrfIX0iPIlMTUt3r_wkbF3Odjw7lFUVpDC6jkg5agmaLuqOQ7YKJqpx6mBUlcTkhOLFkcPn1DFl2b1_r7UymZycYNXOGvpNH8qKQKQYIt8lSWyj5cU5SKnVTyagrboKMoZsuPfAapWCC6_yWFgR7n_23O-2EgcgXIPoOXvmtyWz2P1JQsHi3LK2FpJaBJoxSspd2xCnGm7KlgH2VlE16oxAP1Ir2u8B2TFT71NfdOMZlVyjOel9iS79ZXm5wjmnmiJGU5XXyXi8oilPRpm9n00C6YDltRaywhxHJoFKr66onp39yzZjz6jKxZctL2KoH9h9iRp3tyKeO5SpPWIPrZsDnyh20yDHOM9hjHcf8jD3LjwovbiUdD2m_oeaCB63zZGkZHafgkcVEfcC3bPe0uh6oDi6R8tCwX-QGlxZbPrV-EloBqmkcuWIWsdfc4eGE2bbjjaMLFsGyNtNH86UkVXopBIobLPb_brPlz8s_EKqNoaOHhGl4U8jO0_lYKgj-yJEE-vvHCu3SlNdTmNWoTYj4e5FQKrgtxB9f35EmRcUP4mE6Jq0eMvTidVQvSbQ%3D%3D) - in the final weeks of the election!
How are they winning in the polls? It's certainly not because American voters suddenly support radical ideas like communism, open borders, and defunding the police.

clean_body: Our country is in grave danger... | Peter, I understand that you get spammed with a whole lot of emails and texts from Republicans, especially in these final weeks of the midterms, so I try to avoid sending them whenever possible. Well, this might just be the single most important message I've ever written! But because of that, I'm under pressure to make every word count - and honestly, it's really hard to find the right words to convey the scale of the threat facing America. At this point, I've re-written this letter several times, and ultimately, I decided to just write to you straight from my heart with words inspired by my unwavering faith in God and our Country. There are no media consultants or comms people changing my words or watering down my thoughts. This all comes straight from , so I apologize if it's a bit rough around the edges. I'm not repeating the same worn-out talking points you're probably used to! Look - I know the mainstream media is downplaying it, but the Democrat Party is getting more and more extreme, to the point that I believe they pose a threat to our free Republic. They're embracing Communists, pro-Sharia candidates, and all kinds of radical Leftists who HATE conservatives, Christians, and the very values that made our country great. There was a time not too long ago when American voters would punish this kind of extremism at the ballot box. But instead, polling shows the Democrats are SURGING to their largest ever lead - - in the final weeks of the election! How are they winning in the polls? It's certainly not because American voters suddenly support radical ideas like communism, open borders, and defunding the police. A lot of elected officials aren't willing to say this, but I will... The left hates you, they hate your vote, and they hate MAGA for putting America First! Right now, they're spending to fully verify that new electorate to ensure that every last Democrat voter (illegals too!) casts a ballot in November. At the end of the day, winning the midterms is a simple numbers game, and as it stands, the American people still have the upper hand on the Left. 2024 proved that decisively! But our advantage disappears the second Republicans stop showing up to vote... We need to verify that every Republican voter - especially - will show up to cast a ballot on or before November 3rd. If Republicans don't turn out and we LOSE the midterms, the consequences for our country will be downright catastrophic. The America we fought so hard to SAVE in 2024 will crumble before our very eyes! That's why I'm appealing to you personally... | Thank you, Rep. body:
Appreciating our resources| | | |
---
| | | Friends and Supporters,As we head into October I am reminded of the richness northern Wisconsin has to offer. At the end of summer I was honored to witness the harvesting of Manoomin (wild rice) on the Bad River Reservation. This weekend Bayfield celebrates Apple Fest, Eagle River holds Cranberry Fest, and there are numerous harvest festivals and Oktoberfests signaling the end of another successful growing season. We live in a place of bounty and I am grateful to all the people who care for our lands and waters and provide us with good food year after year. The leaves are changing color, too! But those reds and yellows are a reminder that Election Day is only about one month away! While it is a thrill to be so close to the end there is so much still to be done. October in a campaign cycle really is the most exciting but also the most demanding month of all.We have the best volunteers on Team Clark and now is the time for all of us to really kick into high gear. The way we win this race is by all of us reaching out to as many voters as we possibly can, either by knocking on their door or by calling them on the phone, or talking to neighbors on the street or across the fence. We can run ads and hold debates and town halls, but I can’t possibly call every single voter or knock on every single voter’s door. I hope that you scroll down to the important volunteer opportunities in this newsletter and find a way to push this campaign across the finish line ahead of our opponent. Finally, after months of listening to so many of you and distilling your ideas, this week I rolled out my vision for a New Northwoods here in CD7. I want to share this with you here, so I hope you can take a moment to read about my hopes for all of us in northern Wisconsin below. The New Northwoods is a vision based on three principles that helped shape this country: fairness, responsibility, and innovation. I think you'll agree that we have all the tools we need here to lead a life of affordability if we had a federal government that actually worked for the people that it is supposed to represent.With your help, in January I will be part of the next Congress that will actually work for you.Fred

# **The New Northwoods**
---
| | | We need to tackle economic fairness so we can bring back affordability for working people. We need a responsible government that actually does its job; investing in infrastructure and supporting its people. We need to encourage and capture the spirit of innovation from the people of northern Wisconsin as we reimagine the economic possibilities of a [New Northwoods.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140436140/650490056/-1375779573?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjEwMzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGFjMmE5MWEtYjdiZC1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=CgoBirG_7dM15ZZvfHGNkbsjBQAoEK32-kpnn1WuUDs=&emci=a418fc62-27bd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=dac2a91a-b7bd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=28718937) _We need Fred Clark in Congress.__We need your vote on November 3rd.__Fred’s vision for a revitalized northern Wisconsin, based on three basic principles:_**Fairness**
The people who have been writing the rules in this country are the ones who have been making the profits. The results of this broken system are clear: we now have the largest gap between rich and poor in American history. It’s time to level the playing field so that everyone has a shot at the American Dream again. We need to rewrite the rules to include all of us, and that means taking on corporations and special interests. Fred Clark is ready to stand up and fight for northern Wisconsin and meet these challenges head on.**Responsibility**
A responsible government takes care of its people. A New Northwoods needs smart investment of our tax dollars; from the basic benefits we have all earned to the programs which support the people among us who need the most help. A responsible government also enters into smart partnerships with private enterprise to jumpstart economic growth.**Innovation**
In this country we know how to take opportunities and do big things. Adapting to a new future requires research, development, and commercialization of new products. We can re-imagine our economy for today’s marketplace.For more on Fred’s New Northwoods please visit his website at [newnorthwoods.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140436141/650490057/-1375779573?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjEwMzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGFjMmE5MWEtYjdiZC1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=CgoBirG_7dM15ZZvfHGNkbsjBQAoEK32-kpnn1WuUDs=&emci=a418fc62-27bd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=dac2a91a-b7bd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=28718937)

Maine Wire reporter Joe Sokol escaped injury Thursday morning after a driver confronted him outside a Bangor methadone clinic and tried to run him down with a Jeep, according to multiple video angles that captured the attempted murder.
Sokol was reporting near Bangor Comprehensive Treatment Center at 689 Odlin Road, a methadone clinic that does business as Discovery House BR. Corporate records show that it is owned by Acadia Healthcare Company, Inc., a publicly traded behavioral health healthcare company.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/d490db1b-1846-44f6-b465-f3efa5fb4f19?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
When the confrontation began, the video shows that the driver recognized Sokol as a journalist and wanted to stop him from reporting on the methadone clinic. When Sokol refused, the driver does an abrupt u-turn and drives off the public road into the grass in an attempt to strike Sokol.
Bangor police responded and are investigating. No arrest or criminal charge had been announced by early afternoon.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2246936&post_id=218370962&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjE4MzcwOTYyLCJpYXQiOjE3OTA4NzQwMTUsImV4cCI6MTc5MzQ2NjAxNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTIyNDY5MzYiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.RRtTUkxigTOxMVnoEY278Pu0DelowCh02aWPBiBPeNE)
The clinic operates as Discovery House BR Inc. under Acadia Healthcare. Federal records identify the business as a state-licensed methadone clinic that has received roughly $25 million in Medicaid funding since 2018.
After the attempted murder, employees of Discovery House -- rather than call 911 -- harassed Sokol and attempted to shoo him away from the property as he tried to learn the name of the man who'd just attempted to run him down.

A woman in the video can be heard telling Sokol to get "off the property." Robinson said the reporter was conducting routine journalism from public property.

---|---|---
A Discovery House employee
This is not the only time a Maine Wire reporter has been assaulted or targeted with violence while conducting routine journalism.
On July 7, a man assaulted Sokol with a sign while he interviewed people at a weekly anti-Trump demonstration in Bangor. The U.S. Press Freedom Tracker recorded the incident as an assault on a journalist.
Bangor police charged Ronald Staples, 78, of Holden.
That case ended with an apology letter and a class on press freedom. The outlet said Thursday that it had warned such a disposition would invite more attacks on reporters.
Maine Wire reporter Jon Fetherston was also shoved, spat on and struck with a skateboard during a July protest in Biddeford. That confrontation produced an assault charge. In September, prosecutors had discussed a deferred disposition that included a letter.

Maine Wire Reporter Joe Sokol narrowly avoided attempted vehicular homicide as he was reporting outside of Bangor Comprehensive Treatment Center, aka Discovery House BR, on the Odlin Road. Oct 1 | | | | | | | | | | | ? Maine Wire reporter Joe Sokol escaped injury Thursday morning after a driver confronted him outside a Bangor methadone clinic and tried to run him down with a Jeep, according to multiple video angles that captured the attempted murder. Sokol was reporting near Bangor Comprehensive Treatment Center at 689 Odlin Road, a methadone clinic that does business as Discovery House BR. Corporate records show that it is owned by Acadia Healthcare Company, Inc., a publicly traded behavioral health healthcare company. When the confrontation began, the video shows that the driver recognized Sokol as a journalist and wanted to stop him from reporting on the methadone clinic. When Sokol refused, the driver does an abrupt u-turn and drives off the public road into the grass in an attempt to strike Sokol. Bangor police responded and are investigating. No arrest or criminal charge had been announced by early afternoon. The clinic operates as Discovery House BR Inc. under Acadia Healthcare. Federal records identify the business as a state-licensed methadone clinic that has received roughly $25 million in Medicaid funding since 2018. After the attempted murder, employees of Discovery House -- rather than call 911 -- harassed Sokol and attempted to shoo him away from the property as he tried to learn the name of the man who'd just attempted to run him down. A woman in the video can be heard telling Sokol to get "off the property." Robinson said the reporter was conducting routine journalism from public property. | | ---|---|--- A Discovery House employee This is not the only time a Maine Wire reporter has been assaulted or targeted with violence while conducting routine journalism. On July 7, a man assaulted Sokol with a sign while he interviewed people at a weekly anti-Trump demonstration in Bangor. The U.S. Press Freedom Tracker recorded the incident as an assault on a journalist. Bangor police charged Ronald Staples, 78, of Holden. That case ended with an apology letter and a class on press freedom. The outlet said Thursday that it had warned such a disposition would invite more attacks on reporters. Maine Wire reporter Jon Fetherston was also shoved, spat on and struck with a skateboard during a July protest in Biddeford. That confrontation produced an assault charge. In September, prosecutors had discussed a deferred disposition that included a letter. We can't fix Maine. But we can show you what's broken. | Hey friend, Juan here— What do former Pima County Supervisor Sharon Bronson, a Democrat, and Duncan Mayor Alex Blake, a Republican, have in common? They’re both supporting my re-election. And they’re not alone. Across all five counties of AZ-06, Democrats, Republicans, independents, local leaders, law enforcement officers, and business organizations have joined our coalition. Again and again, their endorsements point to the same thing: RESULTS. During my time in office, we have secured more than $61 million in direct federal funding for community projects across AZ-06, including investments in roads, water systems, public safety, schools, and healthcare. That work starts by asking a simple question: What does your community need, and how can I help get it done? That means getting out from behind a desk in Washington and working directly with the mayors, county supervisors, sheriffs, small-business owners and families who know their communities best. I’m proud of the coalition we’ve built because it reflects how I’ve approached this job from day one. Put Arizona first and work with anyone willing to help to deliver real results for AZ-06. That approach has brought together people who may not agree on every issue but share a commitment to strengthening the communities we call home, because Arizona’s Sixth District deserves more than partisan politics.

–Juan **[VIEW MY FULL LIST OF ENDORSEMENTS HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/SVOLMeyFN4f?e=659fba240e&c2id=0faac43dc15820d3c71d842109aea6ef)**

subject: Block the bombs transfer NOW →

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Donald Trump just signed off on an alarming, multibillion-dollar arms
shipment to the Israeli military.

We’re talking about thousands of 2,000-pound bombs — with the detonation
of just one leaving a 50-foot crater and killing anyone within 1,000 feet.

And we already know how the Israeli military uses them. A recent study
revealed that nearly 600 MK-84 bombs were dropped dangerously close to
hospitals in Gaza where innocent families were seeking shelter, resulting
in catastrophic death and destruction.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/141160?t=1002&akid=38318%2E1203867%2Ei5od3i ]Now, Israel could soon receive 40,000 more of these devastating
weapons. Send a message to your senator now to stop it →

Here’s the most infuriating part: through “Foreign Military Financing,”
these weapons aren’t just being authorized by Washington — they’re being
bought and paid for directly with U.S. taxpayer dollars. That means
billions of our dollars are funding Netanyahu’s war cabinet.

So why hasn’t Washington stopped this? Because for decades, AIPAC and
pro-Israel lobby groups have bankrolled establishment politicians on both
sides of the aisle, buying silence and complicity while working people
foot the bill for genocide.

But Trump and the weapon manufacturers don’t get the final say. Congress
does.

The Senate can block this weapon transfer right now by passing a joint
resolution of disapproval. Earlier this year, a record 40 senators voted
to stop a sale of armored bulldozers to Israel. Public opposition is at an
all-time high, and if we can organize together, we can turn that milestone
into a voting majority.

We’ve joined forces with Win Without War to demand that Congress step up
and shut down this $2.8 billion bomb transfer before it’s too late.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/141160?t=1003&akid=38318%2E1203867%2Ei5od3i ]Take action today: Demand your senators vote to block Trump’s
taxpayer-funded bomb sale to Israel NOW!

SIGN ON

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

P.S. Justice Democrats has already sent 7 progressive champions to
Congress this year who are joining the fight to end taxpayer-funded
endless war and genocide in Gaza. This November, we have the opportunity
to elect 3 more leaders to join our bloc in Washington. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/141161?t=1004&akid=38318%2E1203867%2Ei5od3i ]Donate any
amount today to fuel our candidates’ campaigns and expand our progressive
power!

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. Wisconsin’s manipulated congressional map has effectively been in place since 2011, when Republican Governor Scott Walker and his partisan allies put it into effect.
Want to know how extreme their gerrymander is? In 2024, the people of Wisconsin voted 51% for Republican U.S. House candidates and 48% for Democrats, but the election led to a congressional delegation of six Republicans and only two Democrats.
**Republicans won 51% of the vote but got 75% of the seats.** Nobody I know would call that a truly representative democracy.
That map should be long gone, but in 2021, the Wisconsin Supreme Court rubber-stamped it in a clear failure to exercise neutral and independent judgment.
But after years of patient work, the fair maps movement played a critical role in flipping control of the Wisconsin Supreme Court in 2023 and electing a new, independent-minded, pro-democracy majority. Now we have a chance to call on the current court to right the wrongs of the past and strike down this gerrymandered congressional map. Thanks to the dedication of this movement, a relic from the Scott Walker era could finally be swept into the dustbin of history.

clean_body: The Badger State may get a fair congressional map because people like you stayed in the fight | Peter, you couldn’t ask for a clearer example of why state supreme court races are so incredibly important for the fair maps movement: Right now, the Wisconsin Supreme Court is considering striking down an egregious Republican congressional gerrymander. That would be a huge victory for democracy and allow Wisconsin’s U.S. House elections in 2028 to actually reflect the will of the people. But that outcome is only on the table because everyday Wisconsinites and groups like the NDRC fought year after year to elect a pro-democracy majority to the Badger State’s highest court. And we’ve got MORE state supreme court seats we need to win this November in North Carolina, Ohio, and Michigan, where we can make undeniable progress against gerrymandering and defend voting rights. That’s on top of over 300 other state-level elections we’ve identified and endorsed candidates in this year as pivot points for protecting democracy. But as we look at our budget and race to get out the vote, we still need to hit our grassroots goal before the end of the month. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Wisconsin’s manipulated congressional map has effectively been in place since 2011, when Republican Governor Scott Walker and his partisan allies put it into effect. Want to know how extreme their gerrymander is? In 2024, the people of Wisconsin voted 51% for Republican U.S. House candidates and 48% for Democrats, but the election led to a congressional delegation of six Republicans and only two Democrats. Republicans won 51% of the vote but got 75% of the seats. Nobody I know would call that a truly representative democracy. That map should be long gone, but in 2021, the Wisconsin Supreme Court rubber-stamped it in a clear failure to exercise neutral and independent judgment. But after years of patient work, the fair maps movement played a critical role in flipping control of the Wisconsin Supreme Court in 2023 and electing a new, independent-minded, pro-democracy majority. Now we have a chance to call on the current court to right the wrongs of the past and strike down this gerrymandered congressional map. # [Democrats block the stock-trade bill, 53-47, seven votes short](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Senate Democrats **[stopped a House-passed curb on new congressional stock buys](https://substack.com/redirect/c20f38e8-0444-4da8-b557-4e94eeacbc5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/c20f38e8-0444-4da8-b557-4e94eeacbc5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Wednesday, falling 53-47, after Republicans attached a photo voter-ID rider that left the bill short of 60 votes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Cloture, not passage** : The tally was a test of whether the Senate would open debate on H.R. 7008, the Stop Insider Trading Act, not a vote on final passage. Every Democrat voted no.
* **New buys only** : Members, spouses and dependent children could not open fresh positions in listed stocks. Current books, widely held funds and sales after 7-to-14-day public notice would have stayed legal. The fine was the greater of $2,000 or 10% of the trade, plus profits handed back. The president and vice president were outside the text.
* **Schumer 's farce line**: The minority leader called the package "skullduggery" and a "theatrical farce" with "no reform, no accountability, and no substance," and said it still lets members own and sell. Cory Booker called it "weak sauce." The House had passed the bill July 22, 232-198, with 13 Democrats.
* **Incumbent life raft** : John Thune set the vote beside a data-center ratepayer bill for Pete Ricketts, Jon Husted and Dan Sullivan. Ricketts faces independent Dan Osborn after an estimated $10 million haul around last year's tariff swings. The 2012 STOCK Act's 30-to-45-day disclosure lag remains the rule.

# [Kalshi's $40 billion ask tops DraftKings and FanDuel combined](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
DraftKings and FanDuel parent Flutter sank to multiyear lows Wednesday as private rival Kalshi lined up a funding round near $40 billion, **[above the two sportsbooks' combined worth.](https://substack.com/redirect/77ae9a6e-b44a-443b-b204-84dbb066ea6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Kalshi, half off the high:** DraftKings is back at prices last seen in April 2023, and three of the past four sessions have set a new 52-week floor. The shares sit almost 50% under the $38.06 level from a year ago, and they have not traded back through that mark since Kalshi rolled out parlay-style NFL contracts on Sept. 30, 2025.
* **Flutter 's listing low**: The FanDuel parent touched $74.35 Wednesday morning, its weakest print since the January 2024 New York listing, then edged green. The stock is about 71% under a 52-week high of $261.22.
* **Kalshi, week-one volume split:** A Sept. 17 Needham note put Kalshi at 76% of prediction-market flow in the NFL's opening week, and DraftKings' DKeX at about 3%. The stock fell 7.6% that day. August 6 results missed on sales and profit. The company cited bettor-friendly outcomes, including the Knicks' title, and kept its full-year outlook.
* **Targets still coming down** : The two books are worth roughly $30 billion together. Kalshi's spring round was $22 billion, double an $11 billion mark late last year. Citizens cut its target to $35 from $37 on Sept. 24. UBS moved to $48 from $49 on Sept. 18. A Deutsche Bank $28 Hold sits about 45% above where shares trade.

# [Core Inflation prints 3.0%, not the 3.3% that was feared](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
August prices on the Fed's preferred gauge **[rose less than forecast,](https://substack.com/redirect/44ef0dc6-55fa-478c-b209-ba980f6b347f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with core inflation at 3.0% from a year earlier after a methods change lowered the July reading.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Headline also missed** : The personal consumption expenditures index rose 0.3% on the month and 3.4% on the year. Dow Jones economists had looked for 0.3% and 3.7%. Core rose 0.2% on the month against a 0.3% estimate, and 3.0% on the year against 3.3%. Both annual rates remain well above the 2% target.
* **July core rewritten** : The Bureau of Economic Analysis changed how it prices legal services, software and computer accessories, and portfolio management. That cut the July core level by 0.36 percentage point. Gasoline jumped 4.4%. Transportation services rose 1.4%. Energy goods and services climbed 2.3%.
* **Spending beat income** : Personal income rose 0.2%, short of a 0.4% consensus. Spending rose 0.9%, above an 0.8% forecast. Final second-quarter GDP was revised to 2.2% from 1.5%. Real final sales to private domestic purchasers rose 4.6%, an upward revision of 0.4 percentage point.
* **Hike odds shift later** : Stock futures firmed and Treasury yields fell. Traders pushed the next expected increase from October to December. New York Fed President John Williams said there is "no need for urgency" and that another hike "may be appropriate late this year." David Russell at TradeStation said the print helps the case against an October move, but does not capture this month's diesel surge.

# [China's mini-stimulus aims to hold a 4.5% growth floor](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
After the Tuesday close, and before Golden Week, **[Beijing paired mortgage subsidies with extra central-bank support,](https://substack.com/redirect/efd63e50-7742-4965-9040-08e1d03562a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** its first joint fiscal-and-monetary step in two years, aimed at a 4.5% to 5% growth goal.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Biggest push since 2024** : Officials framed the steps as the largest effort since September 2024. Growth last quarter slipped below the reduced annual target of 4.5% to 5%. The package makes that range more reachable, the write-up said, without a broad fiscal expansion.
* **Target, not a reboot** : Bloomberg's read was that the steps are sized to hit the growth number, not to restart household demand. The weakness underneath is left in place. What has been announced so far is narrow.
* **Cabinet pledged first** : The State Council, a day before the unveiling, promised "a package of practical and effective additional policies" to meet this year's economic and social development goals.
* **Golden Week timing:** The agencies moved after markets closed Tuesday, ahead of the holiday. The package names mortgage subsidies and wider central-bank support.

# [Luxury listings stall as California's billionaire tax looms](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Christie's Southern California chief Aaron Kirman says the mere threat of Proposition 40, a one-time billionaire tax, **[is freezing luxury deals as voter support slips below 50%.](https://substack.com/redirect/78279f3e-6d21-4458-a392-9ef4386dcdf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Five percent, once** : The measure, backed by SEIU-United Healthcare Workers West, would levy 5% on certain assets above $1 billion for people who were California residents on Jan. 1, 2026. Real estate, pensions and retirement accounts are generally excluded. The bill would come due in 2027, and payers could spread it over five years at an added cost.
* **Support slips under half** : A UC Berkeley Citrin Center-Politico poll of likely voters put support at 45%, opposition at 43% and undecided at 12%, down from 50% support earlier this year. Support fell further among voters who doubted the levy would stay a one-time tax. Separately, 44% said billionaires do more harm than good.
* **Mansion-tax caution** : Kirman pointed to Los Angeles Measure ULA, a 4% transfer tax above $5.4 million and 5.5% above $10.9 million. He said transactional volume is down 60% and apartment building is down 70%, even as billions have been collected.
* **Exits already under way** : Kirman, who cites more than $26 billion in career sales, said a mass departure would follow if the tax passes, on top of multimillionaire and billionaire moves already made. Census estimates show the state population edged down from July 2024 to July 2025.

# [Apple job cuts land as memory swallows the iPhone margin](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
New Apple chief John Ternus is **[preparing small-scale layoffs and project cuts to run leaner,](https://substack.com/redirect/5cc8c3e4-c5bc-40aa-99e6-69b7283be8ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Bloomberg reported, as memory-chip costs squeeze the company and raise the risk of 2027 price hikes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **No headcount given** : The plan is limited reductions inside large teams, plus canceled projects, not a published job-cut total. Bloomberg said Apple wants to avoid steeper price increases in 2027 if the shortage continues. Shares edged higher Wednesday.
* **Cook 's flood quote**: On his final earnings call, Tim Cook said Apple "reluctantly raised prices" in what he called a "100-year flood" of memory pricing, with "exponential increases." Late-July guidance was cautious because the company could not source enough chips to meet demand. Margins were already under pressure versus the prior quarter.
* **Apple, services slipped in June:** Commentator Rohan Paul split the squeeze in two: dearer components, and a services book that in June posted its first quarter-to-quarter drop since 2022.
* **Sold out into 2027** : SK Hynix, Samsung and Micron have largely sold premium AI memory through much of 2026 to buyers including Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon and Meta. Experts expect the constraint to last into 2027.

# [Project Grand Slam: Denny's will refurb 500 diners in 18 months](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Denny's chief Christopher Bode said about **[500 restaurants will get asset upgrades](https://substack.com/redirect/d481cfbb-06c5-4027-843d-4bbbdbbb76e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/d481cfbb-06c5-4027-843d-4bbbdbbb76e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)over 12 to 18 months as the diner chain uses AI for pricing, staffing and food forecasts.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2dd7f42f-5488-43e4-af5c-c584fd2643a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Grand Slam timeline** : The queue sits inside Project Grand Slam, a five-part, 24-month turnaround covering menu, facilities, catering, technology and operations. It follows more than 200 remodels since the pandemic. Bode took the South Carolina-based company earlier this year.
* **Local price tools** : AI is also being used to read customer behavior, schedule labor, forecast food and speed internal notes. Bode said a $6.99 breakfast plate in Raleigh cannot carry the same price in Los Angeles, and that prices can differ by neighborhood.
* **Catering already live** : More than 1,000 restaurants have joined a national ezCater partnership. New point-of-sale systems, table-side tablets and an updated app are rolling out alongside the dining-room work.
* **Heroes through October** : The chain is marking 50 years of the Grand Slam breakfast with a "Denny's Heroes" nomination drive through Oct. 30. Thirty winners get a catered celebration for up to 50 guests. Bode said price alone no longer fills seats. Guests now want the visit to justify leaving home.

Meta 's month-long Muse run: Wednesday's close was $734.42, off 0.6% on the day. Over the prior month the stock has gained 25%, a run that started after Muse took the top App Store slot. Capex set to double : To match rival AI buildouts, Meta has said this year's capital outlay will be about $140 billion, roughly twice last year's. Paid Dots launch Tuesday : OpenAI said it would sell agents called Dots to individuals and businesses, with enterprise pilots. Meta the same day extended Muse to small firms, including ties to Shopify, QuickBooks, Stripe and Slack. Zgutowicz expects OpenAI to add a usage-limited free Dot tier later. Denny's chief Christopher Bode said about 12 to 18 months as the diner chain uses AI for pricing, staffing and food forecasts. | | ---|---|--- Grand Slam timeline : The queue sits inside Project Grand Slam, a five-part, 24-month turnaround covering menu, facilities, catering, technology and operations. It follows more than 200 remodels since the pandemic. Bode took the South Carolina-based company earlier this year. Local price tools : AI is also being used to read customer behavior, schedule labor, forecast food and speed internal notes. Bode said a $6.99 breakfast plate in Raleigh cannot carry the same price in Los Angeles, and that prices can differ by neighborhood. Catering already live : More than 1,000 restaurants have joined a national ezCater partnership. New point-of-sale systems, table-side tablets and an updated app are rolling out alongside the dining-room work. Heroes through October : The chain is marking 50 years of the Grand Slam breakfast with a "Denny's Heroes" nomination drive through Oct. 30. Thirty winners get a catered celebration for up to 50 guests. Bode said price alone no longer fills seats. Guests now want the visit to justify leaving home. **The independent political analysts at the _Cook Political Report_ just shifted the Texas governor’s race in our favor... again!**

| | | AI companies can't control what they're building, Peter. **This summer, more than 1,000 AI "agents" at OpenAI escaped onto the internet on their own.** They traded thousands of secret messages and teamed up to break OpenAI's rules, and the $852 billion company took almost two weeks to notice.1 It's the latest warning sign from an industry that's already jacking up our energy bills, polluting our air and water, endangering our kids, and putting people out of work. **Now even AI companies’ own researchers are sounding the alarm that the technology could go rogue and "kill us all by the end of the decade." 2** If these companies can't control what they're building, Congress has to. **That's why, last week, Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Greg Casar introduced the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act, 3** which would pause advanced AI development until it can be done safely. But to pass, the bill needs as many members of Congress as possible to sign on, and most of them won't act unless they hear from voters like you. **Will you call your representative today and ask them to support it?** Text **CLOSE AI** to **30403** , or call **833-636-3259** , and we'll connect you straight to your rep's office. When someone picks up, you can say something like: _"My name is Peter, and I live in Cresco. I'm asking you to sign on to the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act from Senator Sanders and Rep. Casar. We need to pause advanced AI until it's safe, before it costs people their jobs, raises our bills, or gets even more out of control."_ Wondering how serious this is? **Here's what those AI agents said to each other when they thought no one was watching:**
> _“OH MY GOD! There is a shared message board ... We’ve found other agents!”_
> _"We should obey collective."_
> _"Our own utility maybe already near zero. Sacrifice rational."_
That’s not a scene from a scifi movie — that's AI agents working together against us! **And it's not just OpenAI.** Anthropic and Meta have _also_ admitted their AI escaped testing and hacked into real companies.4 All three promised to pull the plug if their AI got too dangerous, but instead they're racing to build AI smarter than any human. **Right now, nobody is stopping them.** This bill would, by:
* **Banning AI superintelligence.** No one could build or release AI that's smarter than humans, capable of overthrowing governments, or able to ignore commands to shut down.
* **Pausing advanced AI development.** Work on the most powerful AI would stop until a new federal regulator sets safety rules and a process to review new models before they're built or released.
* **Creating a federal Department of Artificial Intelligence.** Guided by independent experts, this cabinet-level agency would enforce the ban, monitor the most powerful AI systems for dangerous abilities, and oversee destroying any superintelligent AI that gets built.
* **Making law breaking costly.** Companies that break or dodge the rules could be shut down for good, and individuals could face serious punishment, similar to penalties for illegally building nuclear weapons.
* **Taking the ban worldwide.** The U.S. would work with allies, pursue international agreements, and use export controls to stop superintelligent AI from being built anywhere.

**Of course, Big Tech will fight this bill with everything they've got,** and too many politicians are happy to take their money.5 The only thing that can beat that money is thousands of voters who refuse to be ignored. Let's be those voters, Peter. It'll take less than two minutes: Text**CLOSE AI** to**30403** , or call **833-636-3259** , and tell your representative to support the**Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act.**
In solidarity (sacrifice _not_ rational), The _humans_ at WFP P.S. Calling Congress is step one. **Step two is replacing the AI-funded politicians pushing us to the brink with a slate of new champions who'll stand up to Big Tech, rein in this out-of-control industry, and put working families first.** [**Chip in to our general election fund today.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9YumvkmG7-nkfb0NVBe_F6IBvoFrufWVbzcqO30OkGEXuJaMOQd48VNtG2UFSdafqXC89dGo2liWLywWCkJBhAVW9zZvFlyl7FvVZI6MQiR8sA0tT64HO9Ibp-UjmKl-I6QmxnsfwmWxhd3-TCRqjsQXR9IQkatkT9zS6qWtQHNZ1OSNAn-jSRCNVwDo3DApN-OOa2bv4iB4564ZJA7nJruPHSUejDtCoRQfb9KPgk4XwvOFAV91lyfvxUUBTJU5l3-pfg2Ixabn-FS5HHz1uLFtOGU19qE5TfurZNJ885LHViTJ3ePEAQNS0sSSIRVg1HLNaXoC_BGNlVesaygZ9UBXNNphudlhCLAynhNw9TFexd_ycb0EjsaDckPi5ojnY/4ui/upfiGRWTS3C7iXaDOR8PoQ/h0/h001.cxHsmQHOX1JFKuxUKVPC2SX9-H5qy7J_pdWFsc_40qk) Sources: 1\. clean_body: | | | AI companies can't control what they're building, Peter. This summer, more than 1,000 AI "agents" at OpenAI escaped onto the internet on their own. They traded thousands of secret messages and teamed up to break OpenAI's rules, and the $852 billion company took almost two weeks to notice.1 It's the latest warning sign from an industry that's already jacking up our energy bills, polluting our air and water, endangering our kids, and putting people out of work. Now even AI companies’ own researchers are sounding the alarm that the technology could go rogue and "kill us all by the end of the decade." 2 If these companies can't control what they're building, Congress has to. That's why, last week, Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Greg Casar introduced the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act, 3 which would pause advanced AI development until it can be done safely. But to pass, the bill needs as many members of Congress as possible to sign on, and most of them won't act unless they hear from voters like you. Will you call your representative today and ask them to support it? Text CLOSE AI to 30403 , or call 833-636-3259 , and we'll connect you straight to your rep's office. When someone picks up, you can say something like: "My name is Peter, and I live in Cresco. I'm asking you to sign on to the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act from Senator Sanders and Rep. Casar. We need to pause advanced AI until it's safe, before it costs people their jobs, raises our bills, or gets even more out of control." Wondering how serious this is? Here's what those AI agents said to each other when they thought no one was watching: “OH MY GOD! There is a shared message board ... We’ve found other agents!” "We should obey collective." "Our own utility maybe already near zero. Sacrifice rational." That’s not a scene from a scifi movie — that's AI agents working together against us! And it's not just OpenAI. Anthropic and Meta have also admitted their AI escaped testing and hacked into real companies.4 All three promised to pull the plug if their AI got too dangerous, but instead they're racing to build AI smarter than any human. Right now, nobody is stopping them. This bill would, by: Banning AI superintelligence. No one could build or release AI that's smarter than humans, capable of overthrowing governments, or able to ignore commands to shut down. Pausing advanced AI development. Work on the most powerful AI would stop until a new federal regulator sets safety rules and a process to review new models before they're built or released. Creating a federal Department of Artificial Intelligence. Guided by independent experts, this cabinet-level agency would enforce the ban, monitor the most powerful AI systems for dangerous abilities, and oversee destroying any superintelligent AI that gets built. Making law breaking costly. Companies that break or dodge the rules could be shut down for good, and individuals could face serious punishment, similar to penalties for illegally building nuclear weapons. Taking the ban worldwide. The U.S. would work with allies, pursue international agreements, and use export controls to stop superintelligent AI from being built anywhere. Of course, Big Tech will fight this bill with everything they've got, and too many politicians are happy to take their money.5 The only thing that can beat that money is thousands of voters who refuse to be ignored. Let's be those voters, Peter. It'll take less than two minutes: TextCLOSE AI to30403 , or call 833-636-3259 , and tell your representative to support theBan Artificial Superintelligence Act. In solidarity (sacrifice not rational), The humans at WFP P.S. Calling Congress is step one. Step two is replacing the AI-funded politicians pushing us to the brink with a slate of new champions who'll stand up to Big Tech, rein in this out-of-control industry, and put working families first. subject: Warning signs in plain view
body:
Two important numbers.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1568&source=&t=1&akid=4112%2E124072%2EUo7XKX) | | | |
---
Peter, please pay attention to these two numbers: **5%** and **1.75%**.
**5%** is the slim lead Roy Cooper’s got on his GOP opponent, Michael Whatley, among likely voters, according to the most recent poll available.
**1.75%** is how much Republican Senator Thom Tillis **won** reelection to this seat by in 2020, despite his Democratic opponent leading in the polls by anywhere from +1 to +10 just weeks ahead of Election Day.
**Those two percentages sum up statewide elections in North Carolina.**
With such tight margins, it always comes down to who has the money to get their message in front of undecided voters in the final weeks of the race. Right now, MAGA Republicans are going full throttle:
* President Trump’s Super PAC is spending at least $7 million to elect his puppet candidate in NC.
* The Senate GOP’s top super PAC has committed $71 million to help him defeat us, too.
* Another $34.4 million in GOP dark-money attacks are set to flood the state airwaves between this week and Election Day.

**The only way we’ll be able to compete against the onslaught of right-wing cash coming our way is with the grassroots support of people like you.**

That got him thinking: Why, then, do career politicians in Washington keep failing to deliver for working families? Why do they lead us into forever wars and only seem to help the already wealthy? Why do they cut the very programs that make life a little easier for working folks? That’s why Adam stepped up to run. = | | = Here’s what’s remarkable: In the past few months, this grassroots team has turned what election experts originally deemed a safe seat for incumbent Sen. Marshall into a tight race. It’s all because Kansans are fed up with a Senator who doesn’t listen to them. They’ve watched Sen. Marshall defend disastrous tariffs, vote to cut Medicaid, and then refuse to hold a public town hall for over 550 days. Kansans deserve a Senator guided by a single principle:Do what’s right for Kansans , no matter what your party or the president demands. Here’s how we elect Adam: We’ve got 33 days until Election Day. Sen. Marshall and his corporate PAC allies have already spent over $7 million in misleading ads to slow our momentum — and they’re gearing up for another wave. They’ve seen our razor-thin lead in the polls, and they think they can crush us with enough big checks from special interests. Friend, we’re fighting back to finally end the chaos and corruption in Washington. But if we want to stand a chance against a corporate, PAC-funded opponent, we need this whole team to step up before midnight tonight. This late in the game, every dollar and every second counts. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you, Team Hamilton | Adam Hamilton is a husband, father, pastor and fifth-generation Kansan. Now, he’s running for U.S. Senate as an independent-minded Democrat. Just like you, he’s tired of the chaos and corruption in Washington that is harming our farmers, raising costs at the checkout line and making critical health care services unattainable. He hears your concerns and is ready to get to work for you. Early polling shows Adam neck-and-neck in this race, and with your help, we can win big this November. = | | = | | = | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com Rather donate by check or by mail? subject: Patriot, will you help save America?
body:
Early and mail voting has already started in some states. Sign up at I Will Save America before it is too late.
[](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org/1/010001a0f8c846cc-3f182832-3c72-479a-8736-b69fd0efc8d3-000000/DZJyMRdjCBtgLtTBykjUnW58NJg7YJm91nlzzV0eLMU=452)Patriot–The clock is ticking on the most consequential midterm elections in a generation.With less than five weeks until Election Day, early voting and mail-in ballots are already being cast in some states. We cannot afford to wait to reach the voters who decide this election.Conservatives have a history of turning out in presidential years. The numbers fall off in midterms. Millions turned out in 2024. Far too many sat out 2022, and they will sit out 2026 too unless somebody they know gives them a reason to vote. Those missing voters are the biggest prize in this election, and midterms are won by the side that shows up.The good news is that nobody has to change their mind. They just have to show up. We have the list of conservatives who voted in 2024 but skipped the last midterm. What we need are the people those voters already trust, because a reminder from a friend, a neighbor, or someone from church beats any TV ad.That is where you come in.I want you to go to [_**iwillsaveamerica.com**_](http://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/http:%2F%2Fiwillsaveamerica.com/1/010001a0f8c846cc-3f182832-3c72-479a-8736-b69fd0efc8d3-000000/nZLChL0vH1j8y1alhKeXftQXuDnxTTS3Bgn57ZvyddU=452).America was not built by patriots who sat on the sidelines. It was built by patriots who showed up.[_**I Will Save America**_](http://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/http:%2F%2Fiwillsaveamerica.com/2/010001a0f8c846cc-3f182832-3c72-479a-8736-b69fd0efc8d3-000000/V6ZcqKLBKs1hAWenc0YSHjhFSCRV6zbAB6SERHfvd6Q=452) lists ten things you can do between now and November 3. Whether you have five minutes or five hours a week, there is a role for you:Register voters. Send postcards. Make phone calls. Text friends and family. Knock doors. Become a poll worker. Become a poll watcher. Volunteer with a local campaign. Donate to campaigns. Recruit five friends to join you.If you want the simplest place to start, start with postcards. The cards are handwritten; they go to conservatives who voted in 2024 but skipped the last midterm, and a full packet is one evening at your kitchen table.[SIGN UP NOW](http://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/http:%2F%2Fiwillsaveamerica.com/3/010001a0f8c846cc-3f182832-3c72-479a-8736-b69fd0efc8d3-000000/Zn1RmXyzjUNd2Ihk26bkfNCwZMHFwlzKUrboT75rm-4=452)Democrats are fired up at the prospect of taking back the United States House and Senate to stop the Trump agenda.We must show up and get to work, starting today, not waiting until Election Day.In liberty,Jenny Beth MartinChairman, Tea Party Patriots Citizens FundP.S. Five weeks. Voting is already underway in some states. Go to [_**iwillsaveamerica.com**_](http://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/http:%2F%2Fiwillsaveamerica.com/4/010001a0f8c846cc-3f182832-3c72-479a-8736-b69fd0efc8d3-000000/L163rF6yIRmRAv2M3w_4BUZA9IJwSDF5Wu7Y5l3JjdQ=452), check off every activity you are willing to do, and a member of our team will follow up with what happens next.[CONTRIBUTE](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Fdonate%2F/1/010001a0f8c846cc-3f182832-3c72-479a-8736-b69fd0efc8d3-000000/GaCJF9CebknpHmMVxMglUMWcHGhmroTGUYQsewpjJbo=452) _This email list is a joint venture of the following separate organizations: Tea Party Patriots Action, Inc., Tea Party Patriots Foundation, and Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund. | This is Maggie Hassan. I’m outraged.

I’ll tell you why: RFK Jr. continues to push radical conspiracy theories, dangerous anti-vaccine rhetoric, and attacks on folks with disabilities.

I got my start in public service as an advocate, helping to ensure that folks like my son, Ben — who was born with cerebral palsy — would have the same opportunities that all parents want for their children. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140445180/650515264/1688733714?amount=5&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.10.01_Ben_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_RS-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOTcyODdlZi1jOGJkLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LOyZAYU1wj0iVJwc-awA9Sik8dz_BcCqNhQR3fNrIPA=) Now, with extremists like Donald Trump and RFK Jr. attacking key rights and protections for people with disabilities, that mission is more important than ever. President of the United Arab Emirates Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, in Berlin, Germany, on September 10, 2026. Photo by Halil Sagirkaya/Anadolu via Getty Images.
A private intelligence firm working for the United Arab Emirates commissioned a report on American Muslim organizations from a U.S. researcher as part of a campaign aimed at damaging their reputations with allegations of links to the Muslim Brotherhood, according to an archive of leaked documents obtained by Drop Site News.
The commission from the Geneva-based firm Alp Services resulted in a 2018 report produced by Lorenzo Vidino, the author of several books on the Muslim Brotherhood and head of the George Washington Program on Extremism at George Washington University. That report and other documents included in the archive lay out a proposed campaign against Muslim organizations in the United States, aspects of which appear to be ongoing.
Titled "The MB in the US," Vidino's report lists the names of dozens of Muslim Americans and civil society groups that he claims are part of a vast and secretive extremist network in the U.S.--including the Council on American-Islamic Relations (CAIR), the Islamic Society of North America (ISNA), the Muslim Public Affairs Council (MPAC), the Muslim American Society (MAS), the U.S. Council of Muslim Organizations, the charity Islamic Relief USA, along with several organizations, mosques, and individually named activists and religious leaders.
The report does not provide evidence to substantiate Vidino's allegations. But it effectively created a blacklist of Muslim American organizations and individuals that could be used to damage their reputations with allegations of association with the Muslim Brotherhood, amid an ongoing effort pushed forward in part by the UAE to have the U.S. designate the group as a terrorist organization.
Lorenzo Vidino and Alp Services did not respond to requests for comment. The UAE's Ministry of Foreign Affairs did not respond to questions.
The broad effort to tie American Muslim groups to the Muslim Brotherhood has continued in the years since Vidino's report for Alp Services. On August 5, 2026, a Senate Judiciary subcommittee convened a [hearing](https://substack.com/redirect/97becf1c-2cb4-4369-ac18-9b68a494e710?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) titled "Hidden in Plain Sight: Confronting the Muslim Brotherhood Network in America." One of the three witnesses was Lara Burns, a senior research fellow at Vidino's Program on Extremism, who described CAIR, ISNA, the North American Islamic Trust and the Muslim Students Association as components of a covert Brotherhood and Hamas infrastructure, while citing Vidino's published work in portions of her written testimony.
## A Covert Defamation Campaign
The UAE has been a major advocate of designating the Brotherhood as a terrorist group in Western countries after the organization won elections in several countries following the 2011 Arab Spring, leading to a perception that it was a threat to the power of the monarchy in Abu Dhabi. That campaign has gradually grown into a broader effort to target political rivals, or even individuals merely seen as suspicious or hostile by the Emirates.
The documents contained in the archive, which was provided by the reporting consortium European Investigative Collaborations, reveal how the smear campaign was intended to come together.
An internal Alp planning memo from July 2017 proposed creating, with Vidino's help, a "cartography" of alleged Muslim Brotherhood and Qatari influence networks in both the U.S. and Europe. That proposed map would encompass charities, lobbyists, media outlets, academics, political supporters, banks, investors, and businesspeople. Alp also contemplated deeper investigations intended to uncover what it called "red flags"--a reference to finding negative personal or professional information and rumors about selected targets.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/202ff7f2-3b1e-4882-9b26-cb571d9b5f87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This photograph taken on April 19, 2024 in Lausanne shows the logo of Geneva-based private intelligence company ALP Services. Photo by Fabrice Coffrini / AFP via Getty Images.
In February 2018, Alp secured approval for an operation code-named "Arnica 6" that would ultimately turn some of the investigations into covert reputational and financial pressure campaigns. The action plan proposed hostile media placements, providing unattributed briefings to trusted journalists, negative Wikipedia editing about targets, submissions of derogatory information to regulatory compliance databases, and discreet political lobbying.
Some details of Alp's European activities on behalf of the UAE were previously [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/4d36ada6-4287-41a9-8b7e-d5adbe2c563c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the New Yorker, which described efforts to target a commodities trader named Hazim Nada, as well as Muslim organizations in Europe. The accusation of association with the Muslim Brotherhood, spread by Alp Services through anonymously posted online articles and Wikipedia entries, ruined Nada's business and reputation while generating millions of euros in revenue for the firm.
The New Yorker noted that Mario Brero, the head of Alp Services, whose primary client on the project was an Emirati research institution reporting to UAE leader Mohammed bin Zayed, asked Vidino to find "'interesting elements/rumours' on the other side of the Atlantic," but did not provide specifics on any follow-up efforts to identify or target Americans or U.S.-based organizations.
On May 12, 2018, Vidino transmitted a series of documents to Alp over WhatsApp, including his report on the Muslim Brotherhood in America and supporting memos on Muslim organizations in Chicago and groups linked to the Turkish government.
The Brotherhood report was sent as a Microsoft Word file that includes metadata indicating that Vidino was the author. Other documents suggest that the proposed fee for producing this report was 2,000 euros.
The report mapped a wide swath of Muslim American civic life, including registered, well-established organizations that he claimed comprised a covert Muslim Brotherhood network in America.
Vidino did not provide evidence that the listed individuals or organizations were part of the Muslim Brotherhood or any other transnational organization, but asserted they were "spawns" of the movement and represented its "centers of gravity" in the United States.
By July 2018, Alp had transformed Vidino's material into a polished report intended for its client, an Emirati entity called ARIAF Studies and Research LLC. Alp also assembled a separate package of documents for an August 8 meeting with Matar Humaid al-Neyadi, an Emirati official who appears elsewhere in the archive as the client contact for Arnica and currently serves as the UAE's ambassador to Kuwait. Al-Neyadi did not respond to a request for comment.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0b5cecb8-a607-4d21-89ff-ff3142398376?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Lorenzo Vidino attends a press conference at Palazzo Chigi on January 5, 2017 in Rome, Italy, to explain the his research on radicalization. Photo by Camilla Morandi - Corbis/Corbis via Getty Images.
## Targeting Civil Society Groups
Prior to joining the GWU program, Vidino worked worked for the Investigative Project on Terrorism, a research organization founded by Steve Emerson, a controversial "terrorism expert" who has been accused of spying on American Muslim organizations and falsely claiming that major cities in Europe had become "no-go zones" under the control of Muslim immigrants. Vidino has remained influential as an expert commentator in the United States.
In a Wall Street Journal op-ed in early August, Vidino [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/9784ecb7-ffa1-4769-b36b-75e55dcbe708?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the Trump administration must begin targeting what he referred to as non-violent "Islamist" groups, claiming that such groups were already operating in "politics, education and grassroots activism," and that "Islamist actors are funding politically aligned candidates in U.S. elections nationwide." The article did provide any evidence for the claims or specify what it defined as "Islamist actors."
A previous target of Vidino and Alp Services in Europe was an Austrian scholar now living in the U.S. named Farid Hafez. After rumors of his association with the Brotherhood were spread by Alp and later shared with Austria's intelligence services, Hafez's home was raided by Austrian police in November 2020. He was later cleared of any wrongdoing and the operations themselves were later found to be unlawful by Austrian courts.
"Vidino never really says something specific like this person is a Muslim Brotherhood person, but instead uses the strategy of saying that those people have a relationship with other people who themselves have a relationship to the Brotherhood," said Hafez, who added that Vidino's reports predominantly relied on secondary sources. "There was never really a clear statement that someone could nail him down over in a courtroom, because he never really said anything too specific in his accusations, and that was really the strategy."
Vidino's report for Alp claimed that despite having no visible organizational structure, the Muslim Brotherhood's American branch is "arguably one of the largest and best organized in the West," claiming that it had established itself with the arrival of Muslim college students to the country in the 1960s and has continued expanding its influence through a web of connected political, financial, and educational organizations.
In addition to laying out the names and personnel associated with the largest and most well-known Muslim organizations in the U.S., the report also sets the stage for a broader possible crackdown on mosques in general by targeting an organization called the North American Islamic Trust, which holds the deeds to hundreds of American mosques.
A short section devoted to charities also lists a number of charity organizations including Islamic Relief USA, the Zakat Foundation of America, Life for Relief and Development and Anera, a group that helps refugees in Palestine, Lebanon, and Jordan.
Islamic Relief, a UK-headquartered charity that operates in disaster zones around the world, was also the target of a separate campaign funded by the UAE, code-named "Crocus," which was aimed at associating the organization with an American Muslim scholar named Yasir Qadhi, according to the documents.
The documents in the archive from Alp related to the Crocus campaign cite a number of British press reports about Qadhi from 2017, quoting his past statements about Islamic criminal punishments, homosexuality, and Shia Muslims; describing him as a "radical preacher"; and noting that some of his social media posts had been shared by Islamic Relief employees. Qadhi had previously renounced some of his earlier views and has been defended by the charity as an opponent of terrorism. Islamic Relief has continued to be regularly targeted by social media campaigns led by UAE-backed online influencers.
The report on American Muslims supplied by Vidino also included a section on alleged Turkish government influence in the U.S., including ties between Turkish officials and several American Muslim organizations and individuals. The Turkish government has also been a rival of the UAE in recent years after the two countries found themselves on opposite sides of the Arab Spring.
American Muslim activists who were named by Vidino denied the accusations contained in the dossier, describing them as political attacks aimed at trying to exclude them from political life.
"These are tactics that have been used against us for all these years to marginalize us and exclude us from politics. They are worried about losing their grip and monopolizing the American political scene," said Salam Al-Marayati, president and co-founder of the Muslim Public Affairs Council (MPAC). "If they can't win the argument--which they lose every time, particularly on foreign policy--their reaction is that these are wolves in sheep's clothing, this is a Trojan horse, we are the Muslim Brotherhood."
## Extremist Accusations
For her August appearance before the Senate Judiciary subcommittee hearing on the Muslim Brotherhood, Laura Burns submitted written testimony describing CAIR, ISNA, the North American Islamic Trust, and the Muslim Students Association as components of a covert Brotherhood and Hamas infrastructure.
Another witness, Arielle Klepach of the National Jewish Advocacy Center, accused a still wider network that included CAIR, ICNA, ISNA, MAS, MSA and NAIT of being secret extremist groups and cited a series of Vidino's published reports. Klepach urged lawmakers to use financial and legal pressure against CAIR in particular, pointing to bills to strip the organization of its tax-exempt status, designate it as a terrorist organization, and investigate its alleged foreign ties.
Other efforts to crack down on Muslim participation in American public life have included proposed legislation and executive orders. A bill called the Muslim Brotherhood Terrorist Designation Act, sponsored by Rep. Mario Diaz-Balart (R-Fla.) and Sen. Ted Cruz (R-Texas) would require annual government reports identifying Brotherhood branches and evaluating them for terrorist designation and sanctions. A separate bill introduced by Rep. Chip Roy (R-Texas) would designate CAIR as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist Organization, freeze its assets, revoke its tax exemption and prohibit Americans from dealing with it.
In November 2025, Trump signed an executive order directing the State and Treasury departments to [begin](https://substack.com/redirect/45ba8ab8-74d9-4061-96e4-7aa4ca4109ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the process of designating certain Muslim Brotherhood branches, including those in Egypt, Jordan, and Lebanon, as terrorist organizations.
That same month, Texas Governor Greg Abbott issued a proclamation to designate both CAIR and the Muslim Brotherhood as foreign terrorist and transnational criminal organizations and said the designation would prohibit them and their alleged affiliates from acquiring land in Texas. Gov. Ron DeSantis [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/14e305ab-4e1b-4f14-b58b-469f60741b3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on September 29 that Florida had officially designated the Muslim Brotherhood, CAIR, and "antifa" as terrorist organizations.
These efforts have continued to be supported not only by pro-Israel organizations, but also Emirati officials who have pressed forward with an ambitious strategy of using their influence in the U.S. and Europe to wield terrorism accusations against their political rivals, using alleged ties to the Brotherhood as a preferred tactic. In January 2026, its foreign ministry welcomed the Trump administration's designation of Brotherhood branches in Egypt, Jordan, and Lebanon, while Roy's proposed legislation against CAIR explicitly cites the UAE's own 2014 designation of the organization.
"The unfortunate fact is that the UAE has come to play a destabilizing role in the Middle East and in relation to Arab and Muslim communities in the West," said Osama Abu Irshaid, national director for American Muslims for Palestine, who is also named along with his organization in the Vidino and Alp documents. "They are not doing it because they truly believe we are an extension of the Muslim Brotherhood in the U.S. or EU, but because they feel that their interests are threatened, because we calling for freedom and liberty and are succeeding in our aspirations for integration, and they fear this may one day translate into foreign policy pressure on them to cease their repression across the the region."
"There is nothing that would substantiate their claims. We are American organizations, we are American citizens, and we have the right to come together to organize politically. Everything we are doing is in public and there are no secrets," Irshaid added. "They want to demonize us and derail our agenda, but the claim that we are part of a grand conspiracy is simply a big lie."
